svg.aria-label: Under the question written the right way: a tick beside the word equation methane plus oxygen react to make carbon dioxide and water, with the note that the arrow reads react to make and the products are new substances; a cross beside a line with an equals sign and the same substances on both sides, with the note that the arrow is not an equals sign
svg.text: → reads “react to make”: the products are new substances
the arrow is not an equals sign: the same substances do not sit on both sides
